# Seth Hobson

> I'm Seth Hobson, a software engineer with more than 15 years of experience in applied AI, data engineering, and distributed systems. I founded Major 7 Apps and created the wshobson/agents plugin marketplace. I also write the Swapping Symbols newsletter.

I'm a Senior Applied AI Engineer at United Data Technologies. Before that, I was a senior software engineer at Kuali from 2021 to 2023 and at Apple from 2015 to 2021.

Last updated: 2026-11-06

## Identity and expertise

- Public handle: `wshobson`
- Main areas: AI agents, applied AI, forward deployed engineering, data engineering, distributed systems, software architecture, and tools for the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Known for: creating the wshobson/agents plugin marketplace for AI coding tools, and founding the Major 7 Apps product studio

## Products

- [Ambient Alpha](https://ambientalpha.com): Live market data for the big screen. A native tvOS app that puts market moves, sector breadth, your watchlist, and upcoming economic releases on an Apple TV, readable at a glance from across the room.
- [QueryPlan](https://queryplan.dev): Learn SQL performance from real execution plans. Interactive exercises are graded by running your actual queries, and result correctness and plan efficiency both count.

## Open source projects and canonical sources

- [Agentic Plugin Marketplace overview](https://sethhobson.com/projects/agents/): A plugin marketplace of agents, skills, and commands for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, and other AI coding tools. [Source code](https://github.com/wshobson/agents)
- [Maverick MCP overview](https://sethhobson.com/projects/maverick-mcp/): An MCP server for market data analysis, screening, and backtesting that works with any MCP client. [Source code](https://github.com/wshobson/maverick-mcp)
- [Pensyve overview](https://sethhobson.com/projects/pensyve/): offline-first memory runtime for AI agents with 8-signal retrieval, FSRS decay, and native MCP support. In maintenance mode since Pensyve Cloud closed on October 1, 2026. [Source code](https://github.com/major7apps/pensyve)
- [Tiingo MCP overview](https://sethhobson.com/projects/tiingo-mcp/): A Rust MCP server for the Tiingo market data API. [Source code](https://github.com/major7apps/tiingo-mcp)
